concept.title: How to set up a print server
concept.shortdesc: The objective of a print server is to streamline and optimize printing tasks throughout the network. The print server works as an intermediary between client computers and printers, handling print jobs and ensuring efficient print management.

ul.li: Ensure you have administrative rights on the server.
Ensure SNMP is enabled on the network.

section.title: Steps to set up a print server

ol.li: Log in to the server with administrative credentials.
Open the 'Print Management' console from the Start menu.
In the 'Print Management' console, select 'Add Printer'.
Follow the wizard to add a new printer, selecting the appropriate driver and port.
Configure the printer settings as needed.
Repeat the process for each printer you wish to add.
For Windows Server 2019, ensure the 'Print and Document Services' role is installed.
For Windows Server 2022, verify that the latest updates are installed for compatibility.
